prompt: What year did the University of Michigan begin development of the MICRO Information Management System based on D.L. Childs' Set-Theoretic Data model?
answer: The University of Michigan began developing the MICRO Information Management System in **1970**, as part of the Labor Market Information System (LMIS) project.
